verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents a REST API that covers inference and also automates management of models, deployments, datasets and more. A published OpenAPI 3.1 'Gateway REST API' spans accounts, deployments, models and training endpoints, and firectl plus a REST model-upload path support CI/CD automation, so the core control-plane operations are scriptable. The standard OpenAPI paths returning 404 does not contradict this, because the spec is published at gateway.openapi.yaml. Missing for 10: an explicit UI-to-API parity statement; evidence that account and billing controls (auto-reload, spend limits) and the guided fine-tuning flow are API-accessible; independent or hands-on corroboration of parity.
